Several banks backed by Elan Financial have sent out a bunch of pre-approval offers to people I know. Not sure if these have increased in volume, but I’ve been targeted twice too recently by Comerica for their Everyday Rewards+ card (4% cash back at restaurants, which replaces the same card I had with Flagstar before they switched to FNBO). These offers carry a standard $150 bonus against a $500 spend.

Despite my huge number of cards (this makes it my CC number 43 recently), I accepted the pre-approval. At first I got DENIED, so I had to personally call in to get it reversed. The conversation was actually quite odd: “They saw an auto loan on your report. You don’t have an auto loan, right?” “No, I never did.” “OK, so we’ll send you the card.”

The rest was totally smooth and fast, the way I like it: I received the card on Saturday, spent the $500 within 30 minutes, and today I can see 15,500 reward points (= $150 bonus + $5 cash back) that will be available to redeem on Thursday.
